section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Dispositional Gratitude Questionnaire (GQ-6), a six-item, 7-point Likert-type scale developed by McCullough et al. (2002). It details how a total score is derived, ranging from 6 to 42, and outlines the four facets of gratitude it assesses: intensity, frequency, span, and density.
